name: Crystal Ball of True Seeing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Cast Scrying (save DC 17) through it. Plus more.
text: This crystal globe is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. While scrying with it, you have Truesight with a radius of 120 feet centered on the sensor.
